title: Clothes
about: Everyday clothes and accessories, words that are always plural (trousers, glasses, pyjamas), and the verbs wear, carry, put on, take off, get dressed and get undressed.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Кажуть put clothes on, але take clothes off — не «put clothes off». Порада: коли зранку одягаєшся, проговорюй про себе англійською: Now I'm putting on my jumper. Now I'm putting on my trainers. А українське «одягнути» перекладається по-різному — дивись таблицю.

rows: I'm wearing a jumper. / I've got a jumper on.

items.pattern: a hat · wear / put on a hat
items.meaning: you wear it on your head
items.example: My grandad never goes out without his **hat**.
more: In winter I wear a warm **hat** and gloves.
That's a nice **hat**! Where did you get it?
items.watchOut: Hat — і капелюх, і зимова шапка. Кепка з козирком — cap.

items.pattern: a coat · a long / warm / winter coat
items.meaning: a long warm piece of clothing you wear outside over your other clothes
items.example: It's snowing. Don't forget your **coat**.
more: Hang your wet **coat** in the hall.
Mum bought a new red **coat** for the winter.
items.watchOut: Coat — довгий теплий верхній одяг, пальто. Коротка куртка — jacket.

items.pattern: a jacket · a suit jacket
items.meaning: a short coat; also the top part of a suit
items.example: It's a bit cold this evening. Take a **jacket**.
more: He's wearing a green **jacket** and jeans.
My brother's school **jacket** is dark blue.
items.watchOut: Jacket — і куртка, і піджак від костюма. Обидва короткі. Довге пальто — coat.

items.pattern: a scarf · two scarves
items.meaning: a long piece of warm or soft material you wear round your neck
items.example: It's windy, so I'm wearing my **scarf**.
more: My grandma has lots of **scarves** in different colours.
Is this **scarf** yours? I found it on the bus.
items.watchOut: Множина — scarves: f змінюється на v, як leaf — leaves.

items.pattern: a pair of gloves · wear gloves
items.meaning: you wear them on your hands to keep them warm
items.example: I always wear **gloves** in winter.
more: I left one of my **gloves** on the bus.
Wear **gloves** when you work in the garden.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ɡlʌvz/ — o тут звучить як у love, а не «гловз» чи «глоувз».

items.pattern: a pair of shoes · put on / take off your shoes
items.meaning: you wear them on your feet, usually outside
items.example: I need new **shoes** for school.
more: These **shoes** are too small. They hurt my feet.
In Japan people take off their **shoes** at home.
items.watchOut: Shoes — туфлі, черевики, а часто й будь-яке взуття. «Роззувайся» — Take off your shoes.

items.pattern: a pair of trainers · wear trainers
items.meaning: soft sports shoes for running or the gym
items.example: I always wear **trainers** when I go to the gym.
more: These **trainers** are very comfortable for walking.
He bought new **trainers** with his birthday money.
items.watchOut: Trainers — кросівки (британське слово), а не «тренери». Американською — sneakers.

items.pattern: a pair of boots · winter / football boots
items.meaning: strong shoes that cover your foot and part of your leg
items.example: I need new **boots** for winter.
more: My football **boots** are in my bag.
She's got long black **boots** and a red coat.
items.watchOut: Boots — взуття вище за щиколотку: чоботи або високі черевики. Низькі туфлі — shoes.

items.pattern: a suit · wear a suit and tie
items.meaning: a jacket and trousers (or a skirt) of the same material, for work or special days
items.example: You look very smart in that **suit**!
more: Grandad wore his best **suit** to my sister's party.
Do you have to wear a **suit** at your new job?
items.watchOut: Вимова /suːt/ — «сут», без «ю». Suit — діловий костюм. Спортивний костюм — tracksuit, карнавальний — costume.

items.pattern: a pair of socks · one sock
items.meaning: you wear them on your feet, under your shoes
items.example: I've got red **socks** with little dogs on them.
more: I can never find the other **sock**!
My brother never puts his dirty **socks** in the washing machine.

items.pattern: a T-shirt
items.meaning: a simple top with short sleeves and no buttons
items.example: This **T-shirt** has a picture of a cat on it.
more: I usually wear a **T-shirt** and jeans at the weekend.
My favourite **T-shirt** is too small now.
items.watchOut: Футболка — T-shirt (з великою T і дефісом), а не football. Football shirt — це футболка футбольної команди.

items.pattern: a watch · wear a watch · look at your watch
items.meaning: a small clock you wear on your arm
items.example: Grandma looks at her **watch** every five minutes.
more: Can you wear this **watch** in the swimming pool?
My **watch** is on the table next to my bed.
items.watchOut: Годинник на руці — watch, на стіні чи на столі — clock. Носять його — wear a watch.

items.pattern: a shirt · a shirt and tie
items.meaning: a top with buttons down the front and a collar
items.example: Your **shirt** is dirty. Put on a clean one.
more: Dad irons his **shirt** every morning.
I spilt juice on my white **shirt**.
items.watchOut: Shirt — сорочка з ґудзиками. Футболка без ґудзиків — T-shirt.

items.pattern: a dress · wear a dress
items.meaning: one piece of clothing for a woman or girl: a top and a skirt together
items.example: She's wearing a long green **dress** to the party.
more: This summer **dress** is very light and cool.
Which **dress** do you like: the red one or the blue one?
items.watchOut: Dress — сукня. Але get dressed — просто «одягтися», не обов'язково в сукню.

items.pattern: a skirt · a long / short skirt
items.meaning: a piece of clothing for a woman or girl that hangs from the waist
items.example: My mum bought a new **skirt** for work.
more: She's wearing a long **skirt** and boots.
This **skirt** is too short for school.

items.pattern: a ring · wear a ring on your finger
items.meaning: a small circle of gold or silver that you wear on your finger
items.example: This silver **ring** was my grandma's.
more: She's got a **ring** on every finger.
Don't wear your **ring** when you wash the dishes.

items.pattern: a tie · wear a tie
items.meaning: a long thin piece of material that men wear round the neck with a shirt
items.example: He bought a red **tie** for the school concert.
more: Grandad has a **tie** for every day of the week.
He took off his **tie** when he got home.

items.pattern: a belt · wear a belt
items.meaning: a long thin piece of leather that you wear round your waist
items.example: He wears a black **belt** with his school trousers.
more: She put a red **belt** round her coat.
This **belt** is too long for me.

items.pattern: a sweater · a jumper
items.meaning: a warm top with long sleeves, often made of wool
items.example: This **jumper** is too big for me. Do you want it?
more: I always wear a **sweater** on cold evenings.
Her favourite **jumper** is blue with white stars.
items.watchOut: Вимова sweater — /ˈswetə/, «свéте», а не «світер». Sweater і jumper — те саме; jumper частіше кажуть у Британії.

items.pattern: trousers are · a pair of trousers
items.meaning: clothes that cover each leg from the waist to the feet
items.example: These **trousers** are new. Do you like them?
more: I've got a hole in my **trousers**!
She usually wears **trousers** to work, not skirts.
items.watchOut: Trousers — завжди множина: These trousers are new (не this trouser is). Одні штани — a pair of trousers. Американською — pants, але в Британії pants — це труси!

items.pattern: jeans are · a pair of jeans
items.meaning: trousers made of strong blue cotton (denim)
items.example: I wear **jeans** almost every day.
more: My **jeans** are dirty. I'll wash them tonight.
She bought two pairs of **jeans** in the sale.
items.watchOut: Jeans — множина: My jeans are blue. Замість jeans кажуть them, а не it.

items.pattern: shorts are · a pair of shorts
items.meaning: short trousers that stop above the knees
items.example: In summer the children wear **shorts** every day.
more: Your **shorts** are on the washing line.
These **shorts** have big pockets.

items.pattern: tights are · a pair of tights
items.meaning: thin clothes that cover a woman's or girl's feet and legs up to the waist
items.example: These **tights** are too small for me.
more: Dancers often wear **tights**.
I bought three pairs of **tights** for winter.
items.watchOut: Tights — колготки, а не «тайтси». Спортивні лосини — leggings.

items.pattern: wear glasses · a pair of glasses
items.meaning: two pieces of special glass in a frame that help you see better
items.example: Where are my **glasses**? I can't find them.
more: My sister got new **glasses** last week.
Be careful! Don't sit on my **glasses**.
items.watchOut: Окуляри — glasses, завжди множина: My glasses are new. Носити окуляри — wear glasses, а не carry. Однина glass — це скло або склянка.

items.pattern: wear sunglasses · a pair of sunglasses
items.meaning: dark glasses that protect your eyes from the sun
items.example: I bought new **sunglasses** for our holiday.
more: He never goes to the beach without his **sunglasses**.
My **sunglasses** are on my head!

items.pattern: pyjamas are · a pair of pyjamas
items.meaning: soft trousers and a top that you wear in bed
items.example: My new **pyjamas** have stars on them.
more: On Sunday mornings I stay in my **pyjamas** until lunch.
Pack your **pyjamas**. We're staying at Grandma's tonight.
items.watchOut: Піжама — однина, а pyjamas — множина: My pyjamas are blue (не is). Наголос: pyJAmas. Американське написання — pajamas.

items.pattern: a pair of + trousers / jeans / glasses / shoes / socks · two pairs of
items.meaning: one thing with two legs or two parts (trousers, glasses), or two things that go together (shoes, socks)
items.example: There's **a pair of** gloves on the table. Are they yours?
more: Grandad has two **pairs of** glasses: one for reading and one for TV.
She needs **a pair of** boots for winter.
items.watchOut: Не a trousers і не one jeans. Одні штани — a pair of trousers, двоє джинсів — two pairs of jeans. Після a pair of дієслово в однині: This pair of shoes is new.

items.pattern: wear clothes / glasses / a watch · be wearing (now) · wear – wore – worn
items.meaning: have clothes, shoes, glasses or a watch on your body
items.example: Today Anna **is wearing** a yellow dress and white trainers.
more: He **wore** his new trainers to the party.
What are you going to **wear** to the wedding?
items.watchOut: Українське «одягнути» — це різні дієслова. Я одягаю светр (дія) — I'm putting on a jumper. Я в светрі (стан) — I'm wearing a jumper. Окуляри, годинник, каблучку теж wear, а не carry.

items.pattern: carry a bag / an umbrella · be carrying
items.meaning: hold something in your hands or on your back and take it with you
items.example: Can you help me **carry** the shopping?
more: The waiter was **carrying** four plates at once.
He **carried** his little sister home on his back.
items.watchOut: Носити одяг — wear; носити в руках чи з собою — carry: I wear a coat and carry a bag. Минулий час — carried.

items.pattern: have got + clothes + on · have + clothes + on
items.meaning: be wearing
items.uk: бути в чомусь, мати на собі
items.example: Lisa's **got** a funny hat **on** today.
more: Why **have** you **got** your coat **on**? We're staying at home.
The little boy **had** his pyjamas **on** all day.
items.watchOut: «Він у новій куртці» — He's got a new jacket on або He's wearing a new jacket. On стоїть у кінці, після речі.

items.pattern: carry a bag · a handbag
items.meaning: a bag is a thing for carrying things; a handbag is a small bag for a woman's things
items.example: My **bag** is full of books today.
more: She's carrying a small black **handbag**.
Don't leave your **bag** on the bus!

items.pattern: a suitcase · pack a suitcase
items.meaning: a big bag or box with a handle for your clothes when you travel
items.example: We're going on holiday tomorrow, so I'm packing my **suitcase**.
more: My **suitcase** is too heavy. Can you help me?
Her **suitcase** is bright yellow, so it's easy to find.
items.watchOut: Вимова: suit — /suːt/, «сут»; case — /keɪs/.

items.pattern: an umbrella · take / carry an umbrella
items.meaning: a thing you hold over your head when it rains
items.example: I left my **umbrella** on the train.
more: Can I stand under your **umbrella**?
Her **umbrella** is red and white.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: umBRElla. Перед ним — an: an umbrella.

items.pattern: get dressed · got dressed
items.meaning: put on your clothes
items.example: I get up at seven and **get dressed** quickly.
more: My little brother can **get dressed** without help now.
She **got dressed** and went downstairs for breakfast.
items.watchOut: Одягтися — зазвичай get dressed (з -ed). Put on без речі не вживається: put on a jumper, але не «I put on quickly».

items.pattern: put on + clothes · put + clothes + on · put it on
items.meaning: start to wear a piece of clothing
items.example: She **put on** her new dress and looked in the mirror.
more: **Put** your boots **on**. It's snowing.
I like your scarf. Can I **put** it **on**?
items.watchOut: Put on — дія (одягнути), wear — стан (бути вдягненим). З займенником — тільки put it on, а не «put on it».

items.pattern: get undressed · got undressed
items.meaning: take off your clothes
items.example: I **got undressed** and went to bed.
more: At the swimming pool you **get undressed** in the changing room.
The children **got undressed** and had a bath.
items.watchOut: Роздягтися повністю — get undressed. Зняти одну річ — take off: take off your jacket.

items.pattern: take off + clothes · take + clothes + off · take it off
items.meaning: remove a piece of clothing from your body
items.example: **Take off** your hat in the classroom, please.
more: It's hot. I'm going to **take** my jumper **off**.
Your coat is wet. **Take** it **off**.
items.watchOut: Зняти — take off, а не «put off» (put off означає «відкласти»). Put on ↔ take off. З займенником: take it off.

warmup.q: Wait a minute, I'm ___ my coat.
warmup.explain: Одягати зараз (дія) — put on. Wear — коли пальто вже на тобі.

warmup.uk: Вона сьогодні гарно виглядає. Вона в синій сукні.
warmup.q: She looks lovely today. She's ___ a blue dress.
warmup.explain: Бути вдягненим у щось — wear: She's wearing a dress. Put on — сама дія, коли одягаєш.
Have got + річ + on: He's got a jacket on. Те саме: He's wearing a jacket.
Зняти — take off. Put off означає «відкласти», а не «зняти».
Піжама — однина, а pyjamas — завжди множина, тому are.

warmup.uk: Я купив одні джинси й дві футболки.
warmup.q: I bought ___ jeans and two T-shirts.
warmup.explain: Jeans — завжди множина, тому не a jeans і не one jeans. Одні джинси — a pair of jeans.
Одягтися — get dressed (з -ed). Put on завжди потребує речі: put on a jumper.

warmup.uk: Я завжди ношу з собою парасольку.
warmup.q: I always ___ an umbrella with me.
warmup.explain: Носити з собою, в руках чи в сумці — carry. Wear — тільки те, що на тобі: одяг, окуляри, годинник.

A.q: I don't know the time. I'm not wearing a ___.
A.explain: Наручний годинник — watch. Clock — годинник на стіні чи на столі.

A.q: He's wearing a white shirt and a red ___ round his neck.
A.explain: Краватка — tie. Belt носять на талії, ring — на пальці.

A.q: It's raining and cold. Put on your long warm ___.

B.explain: Окуляри — glasses, завжди з -es. Glass — скло або склянка, gloves — рукавички.

B.q: She bought a new ___ of shorts for the summer.
B.explain: Одні шорти — a pair of shorts.

C.q: Emma looks great. She's ___ a red dress tonight.
C.explain: Бути в сукні — wear. Carry — нести в руках; put потребує on.

C.q: She's ___ a heavy suitcase up the stairs.
C.explain: Нести — carry. Wear і put on — про те, що на тобі (одяг, окуляри, годинник), а не про валізу.

C.q: Come in and ___ your coat off.
C.explain: Зняти — take off. Коли йдеться про одяг, put кажуть тільки з on: put your coat on.

example.title: A rainy Saturday
example.uk:
У суботу вранці я швидко одяглася. Було холодно, тож я вдягнула джинси, теплий светр і дві пари шкарпеток. Потім я взула чоботи й одягнула пальто.

Моя молодша сестра ще була в піжамі. «Я не можу знайти свої рукавички!» — сказала вона.

Ми пішли в парк. Почався дощ, але мама несла велику парасольку.

Удома я зняла мокрі чоботи й пальто. Потім ми всі пили гарячий шоколад.
example.en:
On Saturday morning I [[got dressed|c7]] quickly. It was cold, so I [[put on|c8]] my [[jeans|b2]], a warm [[jumper|a19]] and two [[pairs of|b8]] [[socks|a10]]. Then I put on my [[boots|a8]] and my [[coat|a2]].

My little sister was still in her [[pyjamas|b7]]. “I can't find my [[gloves|a5]]!” she said.

We went to the park. It started to rain, but Mum was [[carrying|c2]] a big [[umbrella|c6]].

At home I [[took off|c10]] my wet boots and my coat. Then we all had hot chocolate.
